import json
import signal
import sys
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.common.exceptions import StaleElementReferenceException, NoSuchElementException
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait, Select
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

settings = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
driver = None

def deadline(signum, frame):
    raise TimeoutError('Digest browser proof exceeded 25 seconds')

signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, deadline)
signal.alarm(25)
try:
    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
    options.binary_location = '/usr/bin/chromium'
    for option in ['--headless=new', '--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--window-size=1280,960']:
        options.add_argument(option)
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'), options=options)
    driver.set_page_load_timeout(8)
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 6, ignored_exceptions=(StaleElementReferenceException, NoSuchElementException))
    driver.get(settings['url'])
    name, value = settings['cookie'].split('=', 1)
    driver.add_cookie({'name': name, 'value': value, 'path': '/'})

    def api(path):
        return driver.execute_async_script("""
          const [path,done]=arguments;
          fetch('/api/v1'+path).then(async r=>done({status:r.status,data:await r.json()})).catch(e=>done({error:e.message}));
        """, path)

    def prefs(org):
        return api('/notification-preferences?orgId=' + org)['data']['preferences']

    def open_inbox(org):
        driver.get(settings['url'] + '/?digest-browser=1#/inbox?orgId=' + org)
        wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, '//summary[normalize-space()="Watches, preferences and email digests"]'))).click()
        wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')))

    def choose(frequency):
        Select(driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')).select_by_value(frequency)
        wait.until(lambda b: b.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]').is_enabled() and prefs(settings['orgId'])['digestFrequency'] == frequency)

    open_inbox(settings['orgId'])
    assert Select(driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')).first_selected_option.get_attribute('value') == 'manual'
    assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-next"]').text == 'None'
    for frequency in ['15-minute', 'hourly', 'daily']:
        choose(frequency)
        wait.until(lambda b: prefs(settings['orgId'])['digestSchedule']['nextRunAt'] in b.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-next"]').text)
    driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-email"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda b: b.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-status"]').text == 'Email batching disabled')
    choose('hourly')
    assert not prefs(settings['orgId'])['emailEnabled']
    assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-next"]').text == 'None'
    choose('daily')
    driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-email"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda b: b.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-status"]').text == 'Scheduled')
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Queue unread digest"]'))).click()
    wait.until(lambda b: 'Queued 1 updates.' in b.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Refresh digest schedule"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda b: b.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-last"]').text != 'None')
    assert prefs(settings['orgId'])['digestSchedule']['lastRunAt']

    def delay_patch():
        driver.execute_script("""
          window.__digestFetch=window.fetch;
          window.__digestSettled=false;
          window.fetch=(input,options)=>{
            if(String(input).includes('/notification-preferences')&&options?.method==='PATCH'){
              window.__digestDelayedBody=JSON.parse(options.body);
              return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>window.__digestFetch(input,options).then(resolve,reject),700))
                .finally(()=>{window.__digestSettled=true;});
            }
            return window.__digestFetch(input,options);
          };
        """)

    delay_patch()
    Select(driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')).select_by_value('hourly')
    wait.until(lambda b: b.execute_script('return Boolean(window.__digestDelayedBody)'))
    org_select = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//fieldset[legend[normalize-space()="Organization"]]//select')
    Select(org_select).select_by_value(settings['otherOrgId'])
    wait.until(lambda b: len(b.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')) > 0 and Select(b.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')).first_selected_option.get_attribute('value') == 'manual')
    wait.until(lambda b: b.execute_script('return window.__digestSettled'))
    assert prefs(settings['orgId'])['digestFrequency'] == 'daily'
    assert prefs(settings['otherOrgId'])['digestFrequency'] == 'manual'
    assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-next"]').text == 'None'
    assert driver.execute_script('return window.__digestDelayedBody.orgId') == settings['orgId']
    assert 'Preferences saved.' not in driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text

    driver.execute_script('window.fetch=window.__digestFetch')
    Select(driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//fieldset[legend[normalize-space()="Organization"]]//select')).select_by_value(settings['orgId'])
    wait.until(lambda b: Select(b.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')).first_selected_option.get_attribute('value') == 'daily')
    delay_patch()
    Select(driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')).select_by_value('15-minute')
    wait.until(lambda b: b.execute_script('return window.__digestDelayedBody.digestFrequency') == '15-minute')
    driver.execute_script("window.location.hash='#/activity?orgId=' + arguments[0]", settings['orgId'])
    wait.until(lambda b: len(b.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="digest-frequency"]')) == 0)
    wait.until(lambda b: b.execute_script('return window.__digestSettled'))
    assert prefs(settings['orgId'])['digestFrequency'] == 'daily'
    print(json.dumps({'manualDefault': True, 'allCadences': True, 'disabledPreserved': True, 'nextLastStatus': True, 'orgSwitchAbort': True, 'abandonedActionAbort': True}))
except Exception:
    if driver:
        print(json.dumps({'url': driver.current_url, 'body': driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text[:16000], 'logs': driver.get_log('browser')}), file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver:
        driver.quit()
